app.name: WiiKart
app.long_description: Semi-sim racing over eight circuits, including seven stylized Colorado mountain passes with real grades, switchbacks, cliffs, and gravity, plus weather on the original speedway: snow that melts into ice and then a puddle, with soft, medium, and hard tires each suited to a different stage. Eleven fallible AI rivals use different strategies and driver personalities, learn from mistakes, adapt without rubber-banding, hunt the real racing line rather than a fixed position on some of the sheets, and range from careful to a no-guts-no-glory sheet that commits to everything. Every car has its own drivetrain — front, rear, or all-wheel drive with a tunable front/rear bias — on top of its plain horsepower figure, and a turbo that spools up and bleeds off automatically with real throttle and revs, no button required; the "use" button is an instantaneous full-throttle stab instead. No collectible power-ups. Cars, game settings, and keyboard/GameCube/Xbox control guidance are editable in documented JSON files. Includes lap timing and a live leaderboard, a marshal helicopter for driving the wrong way, an optional Dolphin input translator, per-track lap counts, garage, manual gearboxes, tire strategy, staged cliff recovery, up to 4-player split screen, and procedural audio. Supports Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube pads, Xbox pads through Dolphin, and USB keyboard. Runs on Wii hardware and in Dolphin.
